content: EXIF orientation bug: phone cameras write pixels in native sensor orientation and store rotation as EXIF metadata; browsers tag ignores EXIF orientation inconsistently, so photos taken in portrait can render sideways/upside-down on web. Frontend fix: read EXIF via a lib (exif-js) or use blueimp-load-image, draw to canvas applying the correct rotation transform, then export corrected pixels as a new Blob before upload. Safer to normalize orientation server-side too so any bypass of the frontend fix still results in correct stored pixels.
